title: PL1-5 Native Acceptance Harness
authority: local QA only; never server authority

required_sequence.expect: Tap-to-Sail moves player on sea plane without free Y movement
PL1-5 NPC remains neutral until damaged by player
same NPC becomes hostile after player damage and HUD/nameplate agree
medium starter becomes owned through beginner progression, never Gold purchase
Haven's Reach exposes repair, shipyard, market, arsenal and quest service presentation without false availability
basic loot increments progression/inventory through gameplay-owned logic
shield/hull presentation remains readable and damage order remains gameplay-owned
early monster is visually distinct and targetable without UI obstruction
elite/admiral hierarchy is readable and encounter can complete
large starter becomes owned by the PL5 beginner milestone
beginner progression reaches PL5 completion path
core combat touch targets >=56 logical px on touch-density layouts and respect safe area

pass_rule: all required checks pass in Godot 4.7.2 runtime and representative Android phone playthrough
